generation.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: Paper Trails circular timeline portrait.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole identity reference, Alfred Cornu photographed by Nadar. Images 2, 3 and 4 are approved Rutherford, Bohr and Alfvén house-style references only; do not borrow their faces.
Primary request: draw a fresh affectionate editorial caricature of Alfred Cornu, recognisable before humorous, in the Wry Engraver style.
Recognition anchors: rounded broad cheek and forehead; neatly side-parted short hair receding at the temples; conspicuous downturned moustache joined to a pointed short goatee. Preserve the three-quarter gaze towards the right and the very large period bow tie and high white collar in the photo.
Comic idea: the photo's generous bow tie provides the entire restrained visual joke. No props or hands.
Style/medium: bold charcoal-teal ink contour, simplified graphic shapes, restrained flat fills, one shallow shadow tone, faint print grain. Match the graphic face simplification in the approved references, never colourise a photo.
Composition: centred head-and-shoulders bust, head occupying the same proportion as the style references, hair beginning 8% from top, shoulders ending at lower edge; eyes near 42% canvas height. Face and moustache safely inside central 76%, readable in 42px and 92px circular crops.
Palette: muted charcoal brown period suit and bow tie, cream collar; natural neutral pink-beige skin. The sepia photograph is an identity source, not the skin colour. No yellow/orange/sepia overall cast.
Background: genuine alpha transparency; empty pixels outside the bust; never draw or depict a checkerboard, transparency grid, studio backdrop, halo, or background colour.
Constraints: square 1024×1024 RGBA PNG; retain historical identity and clothing; no text, caption, signature, watermark, apparatus or full body. Avoid photographic realism, airbrushing, gradients and dense hatching.
